paite: Atung in Thu a-om a, Thu tuh Pathian kiang ah a-om, huai Thu Pathian ahi.
heading: Khrist Pathian Hihna
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

paite: Huai Thu mah atung in Pathian kiang ah a-om hi.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

paite: Bangkim avek in ama siam ahi; thilsiam tengteng amah siam louh bangmah a-om kei.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

paite: Amah ah hinna a-om, huai hinna mihingte vakna ahi.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

paite: Mial lak ah vak ahong vak a; mial in huai azou kei hi.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

paite: Pathian sawl mi khat a-om a, amin Johan ahi.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

paite: Huai mi theihpihtu hi ding in ahong, huai vak toh kisai theihpih ding in, amah tawn a mi tengteng in agintak theihna ding un.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

paite: Amah bel vak ahi kei a, vak thu theihpih ding a hong ahi zaw hi.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

paite: Vak diktak, michih kiang a vakna pia, khovel ah ahong pailel ahi.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

paite: Amah khovel ah a-om, khovel ama siam ahi, hinapi in khovel in amah athei kei hi.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

paite: Ama mite kiang ah ahong a, amite mahmah in ana pom kei uhi.
heading: Khrist Sa Hong Suahna
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

paite: Himahleh amah kipahpih a pom, amin gingtate tengteng kiang ah Pathian tate suahtheihna apia a:
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

paite: amaute sisan hiam, sa deihna hiam, mihing deihna hiam hilou in, Pathian suan a piang ahi zaw uhi.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

paite: Huai Thu tuh sa ahong suak a, i lak uah ahong teng a, hehpihna leh thutak a dim in; athupina Pa Tapa tang neihsun thupina bangbang i muta uhi.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

paite: Johan in amah theihpihna apia a, "Ka nung a hong paipa'n hon paikheng, amah ka ma a omsa him ahih ziak in, chi a athu ka genpa hiai ahi," achi hi.
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

paite: Huan eite'n ataangchinna a kipan hehpihna tung a hehpih nawnsawnna i tang chiat uhi.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

paite: Mosi zang a Dan piak ahi a, himahleh Jesu Khrist ziak in hehpihna leh thutak ahong om hi.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

paite: Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei; Tapa tang neihsun, Pa angsung a om in theihtheih in amah abawlta hi.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

paite: Huan Judate'n, "Kua na hia?" chi a dong ding a, Jerusalem a kipan akiang a siampute leh Levi chi a mite asawl lai un hiaite Johan thu na theihsak ahi uhi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Thupuak / (Mat 3.1-12; Mar 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18)
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

paite: Ama'n chiangtak in agen a, "Khrist ka hi kei hi," chi in apulak hi.
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia le? Elijah na hi hia?" achi ua, adong uhi. Huan ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. "Huai zawlnei na hi hia?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” chi in adawng hi.
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

paite: Amau akiang ah ahihleh, "Kua na hia? Hon sawlte ka dawntheihna ding un hon hilh in; na tanchin himhim bang ahia na gen ding?" achi uhi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

paite: Ama'n, zawlnei Isai gen bang in, "Toupa lampi hihtang un, chi a, gamdai a kikoupa aw ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

paite: Amisawlte uh Pharisaite kiang a kipan kuate hiam ahi uhi.
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Khrist bek, Elijah bek, zawlnei bek na hih kei ngalleh bang achia baptis nak na hia le?" achi ua, adong nawn uhi.
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

paite: Johan in akiang uah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, na lak uah mi khat na theih louh uh adingh ahi,
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

paite: mah ahi ka nung a hong pai dingpa, ka ma a omsa pen, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

paite: Hiaite Jordan gal a Bethani a Johan in abaptisna mun a thil tung ahi.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

paite: Huan azing in Johan in akiang a hong pai Jesu amu a, agen a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou khovel khelhna lamangpa!
heading: Pathian Belamnou
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

paite: Hiai ahi amah, mi khat ka nung a hong paipa, ka ma a omsa him ahi, ka chihpa.
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

paite: Amah lah ka na thei ngal kei a; himahleh Israelte kiang a amah latsak ahihna ding in tui a baptis in ka hong pai ahi,” achi hi.
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

paite: Huan Johan in athu atheisak a, "Vakhu bang in van a kipan Kha hong suk ka mu a, atung ah a-om nilouh," chi in agen hi.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

paite: Amah lah ka thei ngal kei a; himahleh tui a baptis ding a hon sawlpa'n ka kiang ah, "Kua tung ah leng Kha hong suk a atung a om na muh peuh, hiai tuh Kha Siangthou a baptispa ahi, ahon chi hi.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

paite: Huai ka muta a, hiai mipa Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka theisakta hi,” achi hi.
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

paite: Huan azing nawn in anungzui nihte toh Johan adingh a,
heading: Jesu Nungzui Masate
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

paite: Jesu vialvak vak lai a-en a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou!" achi hi.
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

paite: Anungzui nihte'n athugen aza ua, Jesu azuita uhi.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

paite: Jesu akihei a, ahon zui uh amu a, akiang uah, "Bang ahia na zon uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Rabbi (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi), koi a teng na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hong le uchin na mu ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai ua, a-omna amu ua; huai hun dak sawmna vel ahih tak ziak in akiang ah huai ni ataam uhi.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

paite: Johan thugen za a Jesu zui nihte lak a khat zaw pen Andru, Simon Peter sanggampa ahi.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

paite: Ama'n amasapen in amah sanggampa Simon amu a, akiang ah, "Messia ka muta uh," achi a, huai tuh Khrist chihna ahi.
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah ana en a, "Johan tapa Simon na hi, Kifas ahon chi ding uh," achi a (huai tuh Peter chihna hi).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

paite: Huan azing in Jesu'n Galili gam a hoh atum a, Philip amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
heading: Philip leh Nathanael Sapna
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

paite: Philip bel Bethsaida khomi ahi a, Andru leh Peter omna khopi mah ahi.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

paite: Philip in Nathanael amu a, akiang ah, atanchin Mosi in dan laibu a agelh leh zawlneite'n agelh uh, "Amah ka muta uhi, Nazaret Jesu, Joseph tapa," achi hi.
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nazaret ah thil hoih apawt thei a hia?" achi hi. Philip in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, en in," achi hi.
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang a Nathanael hong dek in amu a, atanchin ana gen a, "En un, Israel mitak, khemna himhim nei lou," achi hi.
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nang bangchidan a hon thei na hia?" achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip in nang ahon sap ma a, theipi bul a na om lai in, ka hon mu hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian Tapa na hi, Israelte kumpipa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Theipi bul ah nang ka hon mu, na kiang a ka chih ziak in na gingta ahi maw? Hiaite sang a thil thupizaw na mu lai ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

paite: Huan Jesu mah in akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van kihong a, Mihing Tapa tung a Pathian angelte kahtou leh kumsuk na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
